meta_description: SJG Plastering Manchester offers professional plastering, rendering, and skimming. Free quotes, quality finishes, fast turnaround. Call 07447 107087 today.
hero_eyebrow: Burnage-Based Plasterer — Free Quotes, Quality Finish
hero_subhead: From damp walls to botched repairs, SJG Plastering gets your walls flat, smooth and ready to decorate.
services_subhead: Whether you need a single room skimmed or a full property rendered, we deliver professional finishes on time and on budget.

services.title: Interior Plastering & Skimming
services.desc: We repair and skim damaged plasterboard, cracks and uneven walls to create a perfect base for decoration. Most rooms finished in a single day.

services.title: Exterior Rendering
services.desc: Full façade rendering and re-rendering with modern weatherproof finishes. We use quality materials to protect your property for decades.

services.title: Damp Walls & Repairs
services.desc: We remove old plaster, treat damp, and re-plaster with breathable materials. Stops water ingress and restores your walls.

services.title: Artex Removal & Replacement
services.desc: Safe removal of dated Artex ceilings and walls, followed by professional skimming for a modern, clean finish.

services.title: Dry Lining & Insulation
services.desc: We install insulated plasterboard to improve thermal efficiency and speed up decoration. Ideal for new builds and renovations.

services.title: Commercial & Retail Plastering
services.desc: Fast, professional plastering for shops, offices and warehouses. We work flexibly around your business hours to minimise disruption.

about_pullquote: Good plastering makes a room. Bad plastering ruins it. We take no shortcuts.
about_para_1: SJG Plastering was founded on a simple principle: do the job right the first time, every time. Based in Burnage, Manchester, we've spent over 15 years building a reputation for meticulous work and honest dealing. From small patch repairs to full house renovations, we've completed over 500 jobs across Greater Manchester.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we listen, we deliver on time, and we never cut corners. Whether you're a homeowner, landlord or developer, you'll get the same attention to detail and professional finish. We're local, we're reliable, and we're proud of every wall we touch.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Homeowners Say About SJG Plastering

reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant. Chris came round, quoted quickly and fairly, then got the job done in two days. The finish is immaculate – dead flat and ready for paint. Very professional and tidy on site. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with damp on my sitting room wall. SJG came in, sorted the issue properly and replastered the lot. Took three days start to finish. Fair price, no faffing about. Wall's perfect now.
reviews.author: Linda P.

reviews.text: Brilliant service from start to finish. Free quote was spot on, and they turned up when they said they would. The plasterer was neat, professional and didn't leave a mess. Couldn't ask for better. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: David M.
